text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What could that be? There's a huge crowd 
gathered...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: A mascot suit...? Just what is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, 'Neko-Nin-san'!? The one blowing 
up on Umatter right now!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A chill, ninja-like cat... It's 
exquisitely... cute!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's any way we could take 
a picture together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! That's what this line is for! I 
definitely need to get in line!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!? They even sell merch! 
Whoa... Every single thing is so cute!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What should I do?! Buying one is a given, 
but which one should I pick?! I can't 
decide~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having grown totally obsessed with a 
bizarre, goofy mascot, Bubble Gum Fellow 
completely forgot all about training.
